tooltip_ability_consumed.English: This unit sacrifices itself to attack.

tooltip_ability_excavation__ability.English: This unit can excavate ruins, consuming itself in the process.

tooltip_ability_charge__ability.English: This unit can charge units with the 'Capacitor' ability.

tooltip_ability_eightway__ability.English: This unit can only attack in an 8-way pattern.

tooltip_ability_capacitor__ability.English: This unit can store charges to become more powerful.

tooltip_ability_discharge__ability.English: This unit can unleash an explosion based on its charge.

tooltip_ability_shock__ability.English: This unit can shock enemies, making them conductive. Conductive units shock nearby units, then explode after death.

tooltip_ability_push__ability.English: This unit can push enemies away.

building_ability_lightning__improvementa.English: {0} gets struck by lightning on the beginning of every turn. Lightning either charges chargeable units standing on {0}, or powers adjacent infrastructure.

building_ability_electric__improvementab.English: {0} uses power from adjacent lightning to gain 1 level.

building_ability_collect__improvementabi.English: You can collect 1 population from {0} once at max level.

building_ability_maxed__improvementabili.English: When built, {0} gets leveled up to its maximum level.

world_ancients_popup_description.English: You found ancient writings detailing forgotten applications of lightning magic. Your researchers could only partially decode the writings and are divided between 2 possible meanings.

world_ancients_popup_description2.English: You found ancient writings detailing forgotten applications of lightning magic. Your researchers successfully decoded the writings.

tribes_ancients_info.English: Thought to be long defeated, the Ancients rise again! These descendants of the old Polytopian Empire will do anything to restore their rule.

tribes_info2__ancients.English: The {0} have the ability to use forbidden lunar-lightning magic to create lifeforce out of thin air, power ancient technology, and electrocute anyone standing in their way of rebuilding their empire!
